name: DocsAlot
summary: Turns help-center and developer docs into one source of truth for humans and AI agents, with MCP, llms.txt and a support bot.
description: DocsAlot unifies scattered help-center articles, knowledge bases and developer docs so people and AI agents read the same source. It includes hosted MCP, llms.txt and skill.md, and a Slack and Discord bot that answers customer questions from those docs. Enterprise is custom (not self-serve checkout).
features: Unified docs for humans and agents
